statement: Quartic level of the parametrized web campaign (image degree 4, the same 597 D4-orbit representatives as entry 152, family dimension 5 or 6, identity E(t) of degree 32): modulo 32003 every component of the integrality locus consists of maps of rank <= 2 (image a line) and no rank-3 member exists. This is modular EVIDENCE, not a proof: the specialization of a hypothetical rank-3 member over Qbar would be visible at all but finitely many primes, and one prime was used.

exact_attempts.decomposition_over_Q(sqrt3): no representative finished within 20 minutes (four slices, memory growing past 1 GB each): stopped

exact_attempts.emptiness_certificate_over_Q: 1 in I + (1 - y m l1 linf) per minor: the first representative did not finish within 9 minutes: stopped
exact_attempts.modular_lift_certificate: representative 0, first minor: (m l1 linf)^2 in I mod 32003 with cofactors of 272,951 terms and degree 26 (290 s), far beyond rational reconstruction: abandoned
exact_attempts.conclusion: exact closure of the quartic level needs additional structure (more forced triple points or tangencies, or a smaller family), not more computing; the cubic level (entry 152) stands as the theorem
